description: Source code for a Kubernetes admission plugin named DenyServiceExternalIPs that prevents modifications to the ExternalIPs field of Service resources.

classes.name: externalIPsDenierPlugin
classes.description: Implements admission.Interface and admission.ValidationInterface to deny ExternalIPs modifications.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers the plugin with the admission framework.

methods.name: newPlugin
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the externalIPsDenierPlugin.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates admission requests to deny ExternalIPs modifications on Service resources.

methods.name: isSubset
methods.description: Checks if the ExternalIPs in the new Service are a subset of the old Service's ExternalIPs.
